description: Get compiler errors and warnings for one or more files. Returns: list of diagnostics with line, severity (1=Error, 2=Warning, 3=Info, 4=Hint), and message. WORKFLOW: (1) Edit files, (2) gdscript_sync_files to refresh, (3) gdscript_diagnostics to check for errors. Use before committing to catch issues early.

files.description: List of absolute or relative paths to .gd files to check

name: gdscript_diagnostics
